title: What happens when you open a website
subtitle: Five steps, in about a tenth of a second. Example: http://example.com

nodes.label: Your browser
nodes.detail:
you type example.com
and press Enter

notes.text:
Request = a letter: 'please send me /'. Response = the reply letter, starting with a code: 200 OK, 404 Not Found...

Big replies don't travel in one piece. They're cut into small numbered packets, like a long letter sent on many postcards. Your laptop puts the postcards back in order.

curl -sv -o /dev/null http://example.com

* Connected to example.com (104.20.23.154) port 80
> GET / HTTP/1.1          # the request
> Host: example.com
< HTTP/1.1 200 OK         # the response
